JIO.graceNote: Jio usually keeps the number for about 90 days without a recharge.

AIRTEL.graceNote: Airtel usually gives 15 more days after the 90-day period.

VI.graceNote: Vi usually allows 90 days, then needs at least a ₹49 plan.

BSNL.graceNote: BSNL usually allows up to 180 days.

OTHER.graceNote: Check with your carrier how long you have after expiry.
